text.en: Pet owners consistently praise the veterinary team, highlighting Dr. Anderson and Dr. Roberto for their attentive listening and clear explanations during appointments. Clients appreciate that practitioners take time to address feline and canine health concerns without rushing. Although one reviewer left an unenthusiastic single-star rating, most describe a welcoming, dedicated clinic team.

Reviewers report clear and fair pricing for both routine consultations and major veterinary surgeries, including TPLO procedures. Clients highlight that final bills accurately reflect upfront quotes with no hidden charges or pressure to purchase unneeded treatments. This financial transparency gives pet parents confidence when planning surgical care.

Multiple clients mention positive communication before and after visits, noting that veterinarians personally phone owners to report diagnostic findings. Pet owners also appreciate post-operative check-ins after orthopedic operations, stating that the clinic staff readily answers ongoing questions and provides helpful care instructions for recovery at home.

q.en: Do they perform advanced orthopedic surgeries like TPLO?

a.en: Yes, reviewers note having successful TPLO surgery performed here, with helpful postoperative follow-up from the veterinary team.

q.en: Are pricing quotes accurate and transparent?

a.en: Clients report that final invoices match initial estimates closely without unexpected add-on fees or aggressive upselling.

q.en: Can the clinic handle anxious or formerly feral cats?

a.en: Reviewers note that veterinarians and veterinary assistants comfortably manage nervous and formerly feral cats, using gentle handling and sedation when appropriate.

q.en: How does the clinic communicate lab results and recovery updates?

a.en: Pet owners highlight that doctors personally call clients to discuss exam findings and check in on pets after surgical procedures.
